name: CashChat MCP Server
description: Connects CashChat financial data to AI assistants, enabling users to manage transactions, view spending summaries, and track category breakdowns through natural language. It supports both local stdio and remote URL-based connections with secure OAuth 2.0 authentication.

rawRecord.description: Connects CashChat financial data to AI assistants, enabling users to manage transactions, view spending summaries, and track category breakdowns through natural language. It supports both local stdio and remote URL-based connections with secure OAuth 2.0 authentication.

PORT.description: The port the HTTP server will listen on.

SERVER_URL.description: The publicly accessible URL of the server (e.g., http://localhost:3000).

CASHCHAT_API_KEY.description: Your CashChat API key obtained from the settings page.

OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional client secret for additional OAuth security in production.
